c0ce508e-2777-54e3-806d-632adbdb9073.content: Record the source Memory locator for approved sharing.

a0b32950-42b4-58a6-b1af-dd4638086d3d.content: Record the recipient of approved sharing.

620a1dee-b131-586f-a838-64d853c44a92.content: Record the purpose of approved sharing.

0d377136-da0b-570b-8deb-c662bee5bcbb.content: If a transmission error occurs, inform the user of the failure state.

d26befa6-62a2-5923-a31b-71e73a31e164.content: The local agent can reconstruct its own approval and transmission records but cannot trace unrecorded external processing.

d5d34316-4878-53d9-9ba8-d4d4d3d13752.content: A copy conveyed to an external system may not automatically synchronize with a later correction to the local Memory.

fe68d351-4ae7-5c4c-a4e2-d6c4c7aa0220.content: If a user's local record conflicts with an external system's audit record, an external system operator may place greater trust in its own audit record.
